what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Chad by conflict and violence, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR and shown side by side.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 592630 people in internal displacement, and UNHCR counted 219595.
Refugees from Chad are few by comparison and live mainly in the Central African Republic and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Chad in several periods since 2003, with groups including the CCMSR and FACT from 2020 to 2021.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in 2015 and from 2017 to 2022.
Floods are the disasters recorded for Chad in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 168000 in 2009 to 592630 in 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025, and IDMC recorded the most new displacements from conflict in 2023.

how.text: In 2025 IDMC counts 373035 more internally displaced people than UNHCR; the figures overlap and are never added.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
The sources don't say where inside Chad people moved to.
